aiProvider.title: AI provider
aiProvider.intro: The model LiwanOS pays for. Customers on the platform provider, and the free help agents, run on it. Changes reach the AI service within seconds and need no restart.

current.title: In use now
current.none: No provider has been chosen here yet. The AI service keeps running on the provider it started with.

delivery.pending: Saved, but the AI service has not received it yet
delivery.unconfigured: Saved, but this control plane has no file to write for the AI service

current.tokenCountsNotAsked: Not asked for: calls carry no token counts

form.title: Choose the provider
form.description: The key is write-only: once saved it is never shown again, only its last four characters.
form.apiKeyHint: Write it once. It is encrypted at rest and never returned.
form.apiKeyKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved key (ends with {last4}).
form.modelPlaceholder: Load the models, then choose one
form.testNeeded: Run the connection test with these values before saving.
form.reasonHint: At least 3 characters. It is recorded in the audit log, never the key.
form.confirmDescription: Every platform AI request runs on the new provider within seconds. The change is audited.
form.streamUsageHint: Tick it only if the server accepts stream_options.include_usage. Token limits and cost depend on the counts; the connection test shows whether they arrive.
form.noUsageTitle: This provider returned no token counts
form.noUsageDescription: Token limits and the output cap cannot be enforced, and cost cannot be reported, for calls on this provider. Save only if that is acceptable.
form.baseUrlHintPrivate: The address of your server, for example http://ollama:11434. This is the only provider that may use a private or internal address. Internal addresses also need an entry in the AI egress list.
form.baseUrlHintPublic: The public https address of the endpoint, on port 443 (the default). Private, loopback and link-local addresses and other ports are refused.

test.key_missing: No key to try: write one, or choose the saved provider again.
test.model_not_found: The provider does not know this model.
test.rate_limited: The provider is limiting requests. Try again in a moment.
test.timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
test.unreachable: The provider could not be reached.
test.invalid_response: The provider answered in a form this page does not understand.
test.stream_usage_refused: The provider refused the request for token counts. Untick the option for this endpoint, or choose another provider.
test.endpoint_refused: This address is not allowed: it is, or resolves to, a private or internal address.
